# American Visitor Insurance

> > Comprehensive travel medical insurance and health coverage for international visitors to the USA, F1/J1 students, expatriates, and US citizens traveling abroad.

American Visitor Insurance specializes in visitor medical insurance, student health plans (F1/J1 visa), expatriate coverage, and trip protection for travelers worldwide. The platform offers comparison tools for plans from providers like IMG, Seven Corners, Trawick International, and GeoBlue, with specific focus on Schengen visa requirements, COVID-19 coverage, and pre-existing conditions.
